title: Bilinear tensor product on homology, with cycle representatives
statement: Let $k$ be a commutative ring. Let $A$ and $B$ be cochain complexes of $k$-modules indexed by $\mathbf Z$, with cycles $Z^p(A)$ and homology $H^p(A)$ defined as the kernel of the outgoing differential and its quotient by incoming boundaries, and similarly for $B$. Let $T=\operatorname{Tot}(A\otimes_k B)$, with direct-sum terms and signed differential $d_A\otimes 1+(-1)^p1\otimes d_B$. For integers $p,q,n$ with $p+q=n$, there exists a $k$-bilinear map $c:H^p(A)\times H^q(B)\to H^n(T)$ such that for every $a\in Z^p(A)$ and $b\in Z^q(B)$ there is $z\in Z^n(T)$ whose inclusion in $T^n$ is the $(p,q)$-summand inclusion of $a\otimes b$, and $c([a],[b])=[z]$.

proof.text: For cycles a and b, apply the signed Leibniz formula to their tensor inclusion in Tot(A tensor B). Both differential terms vanish. Use the kernel property of iCycles to lift the tensor inclusion to a morphism t from the tensor of cycle modules to the cycles of Tot.

Compose t with the homology projection and curry to obtain a bilinear map on cycle modules. For a boundary in A, compute the total differential of the degree-(n-1) inclusion of x tensor b. It is the tensor of d_A x with b, since d_B b is zero. Its homology class is zero by toCycles_comp_homologyπ.

For a boundary in B, the total differential of the inclusion of a tensor y is epsilon_2 times the tensor of a with d_B y. The A differential vanishes. The coefficient epsilon_2 is an integer unit, so its action is invertible, including in characteristic two. Therefore the homology class of the tensor of a with d_B y is zero.

Use ShortComplex.descHomology to descend first through the A homology quotient with codomain the module of linear maps out of B cycles. Descend each resulting map through the B quotient. Surjectivity of each homology projection proves linearity and the representative equation. Take z=t(a tensor b).

theorem tensor_homology_pairing {k : Type u} [CommRing k]
    (A B : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} k) ℤ) (p q n : ℤ) (hpq : p + q = n) :
    ∃ c : A.homology p →ₗ[k] B.homology q →ₗ[k]
        (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).homology n,
      ∀ (a : A.cycles p) (b : B.cycles q),
        ∃ z : (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).cycles n,
        (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).iCycles n z =
          ιMapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
            p q n hpq ((A.iCycles p a) ⊗ₜ[k] (B.iCycles q b)) ∧
        c (A.homologyπ p a) (B.homologyπ q b) =
          (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k))
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).homologyπ n z
